title: Deliciu Pineapple Orange 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Vaporesso
description: The Pineapple Orange Nic Salt e-liquid by Deliciu brings together the bright, tropical taste of pineapple with the citrusy punch of orange. This combination offers a refreshing and vibrant vaping experience, perfectly balancing the sweetness of pineapple with the tangy flavour of orange. Ideal for those seeking a fruity vape, this e-liquid is like a sip of a refreshing tropical juice, making it a great choice for all-day vaping. This vape juice’s 50VG/50PG mix provides a smooth and flavoursome vape with ample cloud production, while the nicotine salt formulation ensures a satisfying nicotine hit with a gentle throat sensation, making it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices. All Deliciu e-liquids contain less sweeteners than similar liquids which is kinder to your coil and results in a more authentic, nuanced flavour. Nicotine salts are designed for rapid absorption into the bloodstream, providing faster relief from nicotine cravings over traditional freebase e-liquids. This makes Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice a great choice for ex-smokers and those who appreciate an immediate nicotine satisfaction without the harshness of higher-strength e-liquids. Deliciu e-liquids are an exciting new line of vape juices developed by one of the most innovative and successful vape hardware brands in the world: Vaporesso. With their fine understanding of the way e-liquid interacts with their many celebrated vape devices, Deliciu have created an exceptional line-up of e-liquid flavours that include bold new inventions alongside many classic flavour profiles.
